sources.title: Choose between queues and topics with subscriptions
sources.contentRelevance: Queues allocate work among competing receivers; topic subscriptions receive independent copies. Sessions group ordered work. Subscription SQL, correlation and Boolean filters have different predicate capabilities and valid use cases.

sources.title: Work with event schemas and properties
sources.contentRelevance: CloudEvents fields distinguish origin, operation, identity and subject. Type, subject and typed-data filters can be combined. Custom-topic input and subscription output schemas have asymmetric compatibility.

sources.title: CloudEvents v1.0 schema with Azure Event Grid
sources.contentRelevance: The explicit compatibility table permits CloudEvents-to-CloudEvents and both Event Grid input output formats, but not CloudEvents input to Event Grid output. Candidate claims do not use the article’s old Functions runtime samples.
